item.title: Version 1.2.3
item.description:
Surge Browser 1.2.3

Updates now arrive on their own, and your equity keeps counting right up to the moment you quit.

  • Updates that wait for you. New versions download quietly in the background while you browse. When one is ready you'll see New Surge available next to the menu button — relaunch whenever it suits you, and your tabs reopen where you left them.
  • Every click counts, even the last one. Clicks recorded just before you quit or relaunch are now saved instead of dropped, so your equity ledger reflects everything you browsed.
